groups.empty.detail: Create a group — say work and personal — and add the Claude accounts that should take turns inside it.
groups.empty.title: No groups yet
groups.sessions.help.active.format: %1$d Claude Code session(s) running in this group, %2$d of them working or waiting on you. All are served by the active account — when the rotation switches, they switch with it, without ending.
groups.sessions.help.idle.format: %1$d Claude Code session(s) open in this group, all idle. If you expected a session here and it is counted under another group, its terminal was opened before the integration — open a new terminal.
groups.subtitle: Each group rotates its own accounts when they hit the threshold.
home.title: Falcão Token Router
panel.account.probed.format: Probed %@ ago — the per-model limit only moves when you ask for “Measure accounts”.
panel.account.sampled.probe.format: probed %@ ago, by asking Claude Code directly
panel.account.sampled.sensor.format: measured %@ ago, by the account's own session
panel.account.window.expired: no valid reading — it returns with the next message it serves
panel.accounts.columns.help: The two limit windows: the last 5 hours and the last 7 days. The highlighted value is the one binding the account — it is what triggers the switch.
panel.accounts.model.help.format: %1$@ limit: %2$@ — probed %3$@ ago. This limit never reaches the status line; only a probe can see it, and it is usually the one that locks the account before the other two.
panel.accounts.origin.probe: Measured by probe: a direct query to Claude Code, made when you asked. This is what works for an idle account, which has never served anything.
panel.accounts.origin.sensor: Measured by the sensor: the `rate_limits` of a request this account actually served. It is the account's spend as it saw it — on a shared account, what colleagues spent afterwards is not in it.
panel.accounts.ready.help.probe: No usage recorded yet — the sensor only reads when the account serves a message. Use “Measure accounts” to find out now, without waiting for it to enter the rotation.
panel.accounts.stale.help.probe.format: Probed %@ ago. That was a point-in-time query, and whatever was spent since is not in it. “Measure accounts” refreshes it now.
panel.accounts.stale.help.sensor.format: Not measured for %@. The sensor only reads when the account serves a message — on a shared account this number may be optimistic. “Measure accounts” refreshes it now.
panel.accounts.usage.help.format: 5h %1$@ · 7d %2$@ — measured %3$@ ago. The panel shows the higher of the two, which is what triggers the switch.
tray.tooltip.empty: Falcão Token Router — create a group to get started
